diagnostic_estimators.2state: independent per-R 2-static-state positive-spectrum GLS on Nt=32, T=3..7
diagnostic_estimators.3state: independent per-R 3-static-state positive-spectrum GLS on Nt=32, T=3..7

envelope: min/max of the two Nt=32 model point estimates; not a confidence interval

primary_estimator: regularized full-covariance 2-vacuum x 2-static fit over Nt={16,32}, T=3..7
scope_warning: diagnostic models do not match the primary finite-Nt two-vacuum estimator

truth.unit: a_t energy difference per spatial lattice step; Delta R=1
